## What this adds

The admin dashboard — how the owner runs the business day to day.

Bookings pipeline, portfolio and testimonial management, message inbox, and site settings are all usable from `/admin` after login.

## Highlights

- Full admin UI with mobile sidebar
- Booking filters, search, pagination, and status updates that respect allowed transitions
- CRUD for projects and testimonials
- Messages inbox with mark-as-read
- Site settings editor (e.g. WhatsApp number)

## How to test

Log in, visit each admin section, and confirm changes persist. Update WhatsApp in settings and check the public layout.
